name: dcf-cli
description: Local sector-specific Excel model library with CLI and MCP review tools.

scripts.install:all: env -u npm_config_allow_scripts -u NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_SCRIPTS npm install --prefix model && (cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps -r requirements-openbb-meta.txt)
